description: The slope profile, as frontend/src/feature/terrain/groundProfile.js reads the `profiles` of /api/terrain-analysis for a landing heading: `ground` names each `profiles` (a line through the LZ's middle every headingStepDeg, heights in feet every stepM from halfLengthM behind the middle to halfLengthM ahead, null where there is none, and `lz`, where the boundary is, metres from the middle). `cases`: slopeProfileFor(ground, heading). `along` is the line nearest the heading (Math.round of heading / step, halves up; 180 or more is the opposite line read backwards), `across` the one 90° to its right (left to right); each with `heading` (0..359), `distancesFt` (behind negative), `elevationsFt`, `lz` (feet) or null, `changeFt` (the rise through the LZ, from where the line enters it to where it leaves, its heights there read between samples; null when either has none) and `averageDeg` (atan of the change over the LZ's length), and `words`. Null when there is no heading, either line is missing, or `profiles` cannot be read (stepM or headingStepDeg not above 0). `line` cases are profileLine alone for headings past 359.
